entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Unbelievable. I've been on hold forever. I need to return this helmet NOW. This is completely unacceptable.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is David. I'm sorry to hear you've had to wait, and I can certainly help you with your return request. May I have your name and order number to start?
The name is Sarah Miller, order number 88-1-5-9-2. Look, I don't have time for a runaround. I want my money back.

Thank you, Sarah. I'm pulling up your order now... Yes, I see the Velo-Pro Helmet purchased a couple of months ago. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?

The issue is I don't want it! The online pictures are a lie. The color is completely different in person, it's hideous. I never even took it out of the packaging, the box is unopened. This whole experience has been a disaster.

I can definitely understand your frustration when an item's color doesn't meet your expectations. We want you to be happy and confident with your gear, as your satisfaction and safety are our top priorities.

Spare me the corporate script! Are you going to process this refund or do I need to speak to your manager? Because I am one click away from telling every cycling blog on the internet how terrible VeloFit's service is.

That won't be necessary, Sarah. I can absolutely resolve this for you right now. I just need to confirm the policy for your item... Okay, I see here the helmet was delivered 73 days ago. Our standard return policy allows for returns up to 90 days, so you are well within the window for a full refund.
Oh. Wait, really? So you'll just take it back? No restocking fee or anything?

That's correct, no fees at all. And since you mentioned the box is unopened, that makes the process even smoother. I have just initiated the return in our system and sent a prepaid shipping label to the email on your account. Just print it, attach it to the box, and you can drop it off at any postal service location.
Wow, okay. That was... actually much easier than I expected. Thank you.

You're very welcome, Sarah. We want to make things right. Once our warehouse receives the helmet, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method in about 3 to 5 business days. Was there anything else I could help you with today?
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
